HOW TO FORGE

Swap two adjacent gems to align 3 or more of the same color in a line. Matched gems break and pile into your ore reserves. Cascades multiply your score.

Spend ores in the Forge panel to permanently upgrade Runes — passive bonuses that carry into every future run.

Six gem types: Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire, Topaz, Amethyst, Onyx. Reach a 5+ combo cascade to unlock the gold-glow effect on your matches.
